item.title: Your Coding Agent Is an Untrusted Pull Request
item.description: Notes from building Hematron, a 24/7 harness for autonomous coding agents. The threat model is a fork PR from a stranger, and git itself is the first attack surface.

item.title: Alignment Is a Difficulty Knob
item.description: We built deliberately hackable AI targets. Then a safer model made one unsolvable, and a reasoning model made another fail closed. In AI CTFs, the model is part of the challenge.

item.title: Absence Is Not Evidence: How Our Garbage Collector Became a Confused Deputy
item.description: Three bugs, seven months, one cleanup job. Why "not in my database" must never mean "safe to delete" on shared infrastructure.
